source: SIMD site changelog. Append a row for every shipped update or fix.

entries.title: 3-agent Experimental + Thesis contest
entries.summary: Experimental pipeline is propose→review→decide before HTML ships. New Thesis tab: X-connected posts about IMD/SIMD, ≥50 followers, one payout/account, swarm quality score + follower impact → 0.1–2 IMD (SIMD_THESIS_PAY to enable transfers).

entries.title: Experimental swarm site
entries.summary: New Experimental tab + /experimental/ sandbox. Identity.md agents can revise the page via [SIMD-EXPERIMENTAL] jobs (cap 20/day). Default OFF until SIMD_EXPERIMENTAL=1. Main SIMD UI is never mutated by this loop.

entries.title: Feedback + X OAuth
entries.summary: Feedback tab for bugs/suggestions. Posting requires Connect X (OAuth 2.0 PKCE). Stored on Supabase. Replaced unused /api/bounties function slot with /api/feedback.

entries.title: Collision hunts disabled
entries.summary: SIMD_COLLISION_HUNT=0 by default. Worker/UI no longer open paid 0.5 IMD bounty hunt jobs. Public collision submit still works. Set HUNT=1 to re-enable.

entries.title: Hire burst guard
entries.summary: If >10 paid opens hit in ~10 minutes, Hire freezes and one [SIMD-BURST-REVIEW] swarm job is hired to judge intent (bug vs legit vs malicious). Status at GET /api/hire/latest?burst=1.

entries.title: Docs tab
entries.summary: Added Docs: full project reference — what SIMD is/is not, chain addresses, economics, observer, Hire/Sent, collision ladder, Contest, $SIMD, APIs, status labels.

entries.title: Collision bounties
entries.summary: Bounties tab is now a truncated-hash collision ladder (keccak256/sha256/ripemd160). Auto-opens λ=24, public submit+verify, IMD hunt jobs via worker, optional prize pay.

entries.title: Bounty Ladder
entries.summary: Added Bounties tab: LADDER-shaped λ rungs with IMD purses, manifesto, Hire handoff, claim board. Vault-backed; auto-payout NOT IN FORCE.

entries.title: Vault refresh every minute
entries.summary: UI stamp now includes vault balance and payouts so payment panels redraw on the 1-minute poll even when the cycle stamp is unchanged.

entries.title: Discovery Contest
entries.summary: Added Contest tab: AI-hard missions that open Hire/swarm jobs, submit wallet+jobId+claim, vault IMD shown as prize reserve with auto-payout NOT IN FORCE.

entries.title: $SIMD token page
entries.summary: Added a $SIMD tab with Dexscreener market data, Uniswap buy links (ETH and IMD pairs), pool list, CA copy, and chart embed. No in-site custody swap.

entries.title: Hire daily cap 400
entries.summary: Raised the SIMD payer daily job cap from 10 to 400.

entries.title: In-site job results
entries.summary: Job results open inside SIMD: objective, files, text/image/audio/video previews via a proxied artifact route, plus a link to the Identity.md explorer.

entries.title: Hire media kinds
entries.summary: Hire can open report, image, audio, or video jobs using the documented create-image, create-audio, create-video, and research-report skills.

entries.title: Logs view
entries.summary: Added a Logs tab that records shipped updates and fixes from the vault/token setup onward.

entries.title: Hire paste fix
entries.summary: Stopped the minute refresh from remounting Hire while typing, and made Ctrl+V / paste insert into the task field.

entries.title: Sent from this site
entries.summary: Hire now lists jobs opened through the site: objective when public, state, job link, and payment hash from the SIMD payer wallet.

entries.title: Server-paid Hire
entries.summary: Removed Connect wallet. Open job is paid by SIMD_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY with a daily cap. Verified an admitted job on Identity.md.

entries.title: Wallet Hire payment
entries.summary: Hire could check a report, then connect a wallet and sign the documented 0.5 IMD Permit2 payment through the server proxy.

entries.title: Hire check
entries.summary: Added Hire with public POST /requests/check for research-report jobs. Nothing was paid until the wallet/server payer step landed.

entries.title: Payout counters
entries.summary: Vault panel shows Distributed, Jobs paid, Full price, and Recipients from outgoing IMD transfers.

entries.title: Reward share 100%
entries.summary: Named reward share changed from 50% to 100% of the Identity.md task price (0.5 IMD). Full-price rows match that exact amount.

entries.title: Ecosystem panel
entries.summary: Network view adds public IMD reads: hourly steps, publication counts, schedules, and top seats by accepted work.

entries.title: Docs aesthetic
entries.summary: Site restyled closer to imd.fun/docs: black ground, IBM Plex Mono, boxed nav, inverted active item.

entries.title: Reward share 50%
entries.summary: Prepared reward text moved from 25% to 50% of the verified task price before the later 100% rule.

entries.title: Vault and token contracts
entries.summary: Header CA set to SIMD token 0xComingSoon. Vault 0xd60483Eb8004e3DE3e283b3efF0e67FBb57f9B21 tracks IMD balance and outgoing payout transfers. Test contracts stayed out of the UI.

entries.title: Live public site
entries.summary: www.si-md.xyz serves live cycle data every minute. Times use America/New_York labeled ET. Diamond graph kept as the Network hero.
